review_summary: Round 2 finally reads as a coherent figure, but the face silhouette still protrudes too far left, the major value structure is flat, and the garment/headwrap need clear light-vs-shadow masses before any facial features.

actions.intent: remove the excessive leftward face protrusions before modeling
actions.decision: The current face sticks too far into the background on the left. Repaint the outer-left fringe with the ground color instead of trying to hide it later with detail.

actions.intent: make the chin and jaw taper instead of forming a blunt lower-left block
actions.decision: The jaw is too square and low. Cut back the lower-left edge with a few small ground-color strokes; this is a subtractive correction, not a new decorative step.

actions.intent: establish the broad lit plane on forehead-cheek-chin
actions.decision: Before eyes or lips, the reference is recognizable from the large warm light on the front-left face against the darker ear/neck side.

actions.intent: separate the illuminated upper-left blue wrap from its dark lower-right half
actions.decision: The blue wrap is not one flat blue mass. Add only the broad light family on the upper-left, leaving the existing dark lower-right passage intact.

actions.intent: turn the yellow crown with one lighter upper passage
actions.decision: The crown currently reads as a flat ochre bar. Place one broad lighter family over the top-left rather than drawing folds yet.

actions.intent: establish the golden light falling over the left shoulder and sleeve
actions.decision: The jacket must first read as a lit ochre shoulder against a large green-brown shadow. Add the light as one broad family, not seam detail.

actions.intent: place the large dark olive shadow on the upper-right jacket
actions.decision: A strong green-brown shadow mass begins behind the collar and extends down the right shoulder; this contrast is more important than garment texture now.

actions.intent: give the hanging cloth a bright left-facing strip so it reads as folded fabric
actions.decision: The long cloth is currently a flat vertical ochre slab. Add only a narrow light passage on its left/center; do not draw individual folds yet.
